egress.terms: Free allowance 10 GB per month of CDN origin (回源) traffic; beyond it CDN origin traffic is metered at 0.15 yuan/GB. Internet outbound traffic is a separate meter with no free allowance, priced 0.26 yuan/GB for 0 to 100 TB in the first region tab and 0.29 yuan/GB in the other mainland region tabs.
